source: a gun game where at the start there will be three maps and whichever one has the most votes they will all teleport to and then be separated into 2 teams with all players each have 1 sniper infinite grenades 1 normal gun and a mini gun that can only be used for 30 secs and there will be a 130 second timer so whatever team has the most kills when the timer is out wins

image_prompt.text: Balanced bases at opposite ends for the two teams, shielded from enemy sniper lines
Waist-high and full-body cover distributed evenly across every lane
Narrow transitions where lanes meet, concentrating the fighting into contested ground

layout_placement.text: Two opposing team spawns, one per team, split at the start of the round
Three separate playable maps, one of which is chosen by player vote before the round starts
A 130 second round timer; the team with the most kills when it expires wins

notes: Three votable maps means three genuinely separate builds, which is a P4 concern, but no loaded shape or option carries P4 so the emitted route stays P0.
No map content is described at all - the prompt specifies rules, weapons and timing only.
The pre-round voting space is not part of any of the three combat maps and has no home in this genre file.

open_questions.ask: What should the maps look like - military, urban, sci-fi, something else?
Should all three maps share a lane layout, or should they differ (open, close-quarters, vertical)?

coverage_missing.ask: Do the three maps need different layouts, and what makes each distinct?
How many players per team, so the maps can be sized to them?

answers.ask: What should the maps look like - military, urban, sci-fi, something else?
answers.answer: Use a military theme for all three maps, matching the gun-game combat.

answers.ask: Should all three maps share a lane layout, or should they differ (open, close-quarters, vertical)?
answers.answer: Have the three maps differ: one open, one close-quarters, and one with vertical areas, so the vote gives players distinct choices.
